description: This file defines a Java interface 'LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTagData' which provides method signatures for accessing delinquency tag data related to loan installments, including nested interface for delinquency range details.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTagData
classes.description: Interface providing methods to access details of loan installment delinquency tags, including information like ID, delinquency range, and outstanding amount.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTagData.InstallmentDelinquencyRange
classes.description: Nested interface defining methods to access delinquency range details such as ID, classification, and age days boundaries.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the delinquency tag or range.

methods.name: getDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Returns the delinquency range details associated with the loan installment delinquency tag.

methods.name: getOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Returns the outstanding amount related to the delinquency tag.

methods.name: getClassification
methods.description: Returns the classification of the delinquency range.

methods.name: getMinimumAgeDays
methods.description: Returns the minimum age (in days) for the delinquency range.

methods.name: getMaximumAgeDays
methods.description: Returns the maximum age (in days) for the delinquency range.
